ResearchProjectDef.label: Westeros clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the tailoring traditions of Westeros to produce its tunics, quilted gambesons, heavy cloaks, utility belts, and warm face wraps.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Westeros armory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master the armoring and weaponsmithing traditions of Westeros to forge elite steel arms, regional helmets, gorgets, chainmail, scale armor, plated leather, and full plate.
